scope: Per-session source-balanced supervised ridge/OLS routing suggestion. No neural network or pretrained weights; runtime remains deterministic Matrix algebra, suggestions are exported for review only.

method.selection: Inner leave-one-source-out; nested outer leave-one-source-out predicts excluded sources with their penalty selected without them. Full-data selected penalty used for final learned matrix.
method.solver: Weighted thin SVD; unregularized singular support checked before regularization, in each training/selection fold and bootstrap
method.uncertainty: 200 source-group bootstrap fits at selected full-data penalty, seed20491026. Combine2.5/97.5percentile endpoints with outer-fold coefficient extrema. Heuristic, not calibrated probability or simultaneous confidence; conditional bootstrap omits full retuning.
method.export: Remove coefficients below1e-7 absolute, cast float32; revalidate changed matrix and actual native routing. Signed output-major matrix; explicit channel maps and labels.

evaluation.fresh_validation: Four new97-row sources per accepted session at input range+/-0.8, versus fit examples+/-0.6. No example rows reused.

limitations: Source IDs and duplicate guards do not prove independence; edits/segments/level variants of one recording must remain grouped.
No delay, clipping, hidden processing, time variation or semantic channel-role inference is modeled.
Row L1 bound supplies a coherent sample-amplitude relationship for unit inputs, not semantic correctness or loudness matching.
Synthetic evidence only; no natural user calibration examples, listening or host/UI integration.
